summary: The Bootstrap and Stochastic Consolidation windows now look and work like the other method windows.
details: Simulate or Consolidate, Save and Cancel sit together at the bottom, and the run state shows beside the window title.
A running animation shows while a run is in progress.
Tables select, copy and scroll like the other method tables, and Results can be downloaded as a CSV.
On Residuals the chart sits below the triangle, and both widen with the window.
